subject: Mutual action plan and security gates — timeline + DPA redline
messages:
From: Amelia Stone <amelia@crestline.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@crestline.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Security & Close Timeline

Jonas — thanks for the intro call earlier. As we discussed, Crestline would like a concise mutual action plan that covers the security/compliance gates we need to hit before procurement can sign off. High level asks from my side: 

- SOC 2: access to the latest Type II report and inventory of scoped services.
- SIG/CAIQ: a completed SIG spreadsheet (or prioritized subset) we can review; we will triage critical questions first.
- DPA: our legal team will upload a redline but we need to understand Redwood's standard retention buckets and EU residency options.
- Timeline: target commercial close by 2026-12-15; security gating must be complete two weeks prior.

Could you send a short MAP (tasks, owners, dates) and call out any gaps you anticipate on SOC2/SIG evidence? I attached a one-page customer intake and our suggested internal milestones (crestline-map-initial.xlsx).

Appreciate a single point of contact for evidence intake.

—Amelia
Amelia Stone
VP, IT Risk & Compliance
Crestline Corporation
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Stone <amelia@crestline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Security & Close Timeline

Amelia — thanks, this is great context. Attaching a draft MAP that maps the security gates to dates and owners (redwood-map-v1.xlsx). High-level proposal:

- 11/02: Security intake and SIG prioritization workshop (Kimberly to lead).
- 11/05: Delivery of prioritized SIG subset + evidence pointers.
- 11/12: SOC 2 artifacts handoff (control descriptions, system inventory).
- 11/28: Legal to confirm DPA redline; Redwood provides standard retention matrix and subprocessor list.
- 12/01: Final acceptance of security gates.

We can compress if Crestline needs an earlier close, but we want a two-week buffer before your contractual execution date. Kimberly — can you run the SIG workshop and confirm a minimal evidence set for Crestline's procurement? Marissa — I'll put you on submission cadence for evidence and the SOW/DocuSign routing.

Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/crestline-map-2026 (MAP & evidence folder)

If that works I'll update dates after the SIG workshop.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Partnerships Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Stone <amelia@crestline.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: SIG prioritization + SOC 2 scope (workshop notes)

Amelia / team — good workshop earlier. Summary and concrete asks below. Attaching a one-pager on how we share SOC 2 artifacts and the prioritized SIG checklist (SOC2-OnePager.pdf, SIG-priority-list.xlsx).

Summary / next steps: 
- Scope: Redwood's SOC 2 Type II covers our hosted API and control plane; dedicated/private options have additional attestations scoped on request. We'll flag any scope gaps and provide compensating evidence where relevant.
- SIG/CAIQ: we've prioritized 18 questions for procurement (see sheet). Please confirm which 3 controls you need validated for go/no-go.
- Evidence intake: Marissa will collect artifacts (system diagrams, control descriptions, runbooks). Deliverables planned: prioritized SIG + evidence pointers (11/05), SOC2 artifacts package (11/12).
- Data retention: our standard retention tiers are 30/90/365/730 days; we support EU data residency for Dedicated/Private via configuration — Hosted includes regional routing within our GDPR-compliant regions but not guaranteed residency unless Dedicated/Private is purchased.
- DPA considerations: standard clause includes subprocessor list and 30/90/365 retention options. If you require EU-residency guarantees we will need an addendum (can be included in the DPA redline process).

Open questions for Crestline legal: 
1) Is a 365-day retention window acceptable for production logs, or do you require 730?
2) Do you need HSM/KMS integration specifics in the DPA? 

I will upload the prioritized SIG sheet and mark the evidence type (artifact, pointer, SOC excerpt).

—Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Stone <amelia@crestline.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: MAP commitments + DPA redline placeholder

Team — looping in our legal ops lane so procurement has a place to review redlines quickly. Attachments: DPA-redline.docx (placeholder redline from Crestline), and I created the submission tracker in the shared drive.

Plan: once Crestline legal uploads the redline we will: 
- 48 hours for initial redline review (legal ops).
- 3 business days for security to confirm any technical feasibility or required changes.
- If retention or residency clauses require Dedicated/Private, we'll flag commercial options and timeline (typically a 4–6 week provisioning window).

Action items: 
- Crestline legal to confirm preferred retention window and whether EU residency is required for production data (legal@crestline.com).
- Jonas to confirm final commercial close target so we can align DocuSign and SOW.

DocuSign (provisional SOW) link will be posted once redline is accepted.

—Marissa Cole
Customer Success Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Amelia Stone <amelia@crestline.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Legal Team <legal@crestline.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Security & Close Timeline

Thanks — this plan looks tidy and actionable. A few clarifications from our legal team: we prefer a 730-day retention window for audit logs (will include in the redline), and we do require EU residency for production customer data (Crestline processes EU personal data). We understand that may necessitate Dedicated capacity or an addendum; please flag costs/lead time.

On the SIG subset: please surface the three highest-risk controls as discussed (I called them out in the SIG spreadsheet during the call). We'll aim to triage evidence requests this week so your team can start deliveries.

Quoting Kimberly's timeline below for clarity: 
> - 11/05: Delivery of prioritized SIG subset + evidence pointers.
> - 11/12: SOC 2 artifacts handoff (control descriptions, system inventory).
> - 11/28: Legal to confirm DPA redline; Redwood provides standard retention matrix and subprocessor list.

We'd like to keep the target close date of 2026-12-15 if feasible. Please confirm whether the EU-residency requirement pushes us past that date and the expected delta.

Best,
Amelia Stone
VP, IT Risk & Compliance
Crestline Corporation
